description.value: Roast is a Victoria sandwich shop that has been crafting fast-casual meals from locally sourced, naturally raised BC meats since 2013, with a menu centred on beef, porchetta, chicken, and veggie sandwiches alongside superfood salads. The Uptown location is one of two active Victoria outlets, situated in a shopping centre setting convenient for a midday stop on a city or suburban ride. The shop is notably BC's first sandwich shop to offer living wages and runs a reusable container program in partnership with the Bread and Butter Collective.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is an active Roast Meat & Sandwich Shop location at Uptown, Victoria, with the check_date of 2025-08-07 corroborating it remains open. Takeout is clearly the primary service model ('Fresh meat and greens are ready to go, all day'), and a veggie sandwich option is listed alongside beef, porchetta, and chicken. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags addresses bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or charging.
concerns: OSM name is lowercase 'roast'; website consistently uses 'Roast' or 'Roast Meat & Sandwich Shop' — minor capitalisation discrepancy.

No street address available in OSM or on the website; addr:floor tag value 'G, Uptown Boulevard' appears to indicate ground floor of the Uptown Boulevard shopping centre but is not a complete postal address.
Victoria Public Market location noted on website as closing June 20th 2025 — that location appears now closed, but this record is for the Uptown location which remains listed as active.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, actively operating sandwich shop with a recent OSM check_date and confirmed active listing on the business's own website. Straightforward food-and-drink inclusion.
